narrative.text:
Upstream `main` is still at the requested base. I’ve read the contribution rules and existing history, reaction, and ACK paths. I’ll preserve the structured history format and byte limits, leave live messages unchanged, and put `remove_reaction` in the same feature set as `add_reaction`.
The base suite passed on all three Node versions: 583 tests, zero failures each. The new tests went red against the base and now pass, including byte-identical output for messages without reactions. Slack’s docs confirm that history carries reactions under the existing history scopes; removal uses the already-granted `reactions:write`.
The local commit is complete. All final gates passed at that commit: 605/605 tests on each Node version, typecheck and build on 22.23.3 and 24.22.1, five consecutive runs of the 22 new tests, and changelog validation. Four mutations were caught. The overlap with PRs #55/#56 is `src/slack-adapter.ts` and `src/server.ts`; neither PR is a dependency.
